title: Certificate core machine construction
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $P$ over the Boolean alphabet with $P.k$ work tapes, an injection from the indices of $1+P.k$ tapes into the indices of $k$ tapes, and a designated tape index among those $k$ tapes, the construction produces a finite Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $((P.State\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})\sqcup\{\ast\})\sqcup\{0,1,2\}$. Its transition machine is obtained by composing the embedded virtual-host emission machine for $P$ with the certificate-verdict machine on the designated tape, using the unit state and parameter $0$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $P$ over the Boolean alphabet
An injection from the indices of $1+P.k$ tapes into the indices of $k$ tapes
A designated tape index among the $k$ tapes
caveat: The supplied definitions do not explain the virtual-host emission, embedding, or composition constructions, so their operational meaning cannot be stated more explicitly from the formal statement alone.
